title: Binance says it obtained a $6.5B freezing order from an Abu Dhabi court, targeting unidentified perpetrators of the October 29 attack on the exchange (Teresa Xie/Bloomberg)
summary: Teresa Xie / Bloomberg: Binance says it obtained a $6.5B freezing order from an Abu Dhabi court, targeting unidentified perpetrators of the October 29 attack on the exchange — Binance said it obtained a $6.5 billion freezing order from an Abu Dhabi court as the cryptocurrency exchange seeks to recover assets stolen in a massive hack last month.
